Test Report 
CardanoRnR Smart Contact Test Scenario
 LInk : https://github.com/AIQUANT-Tech/CardanoRnR/tree/main/TestReport/RnRSmartContractTestScenario 
・The tests cover the submission of reviews by a Business User (Owner), both with valid and invalid data, to ensure the smart contract correctly accepts or rejects them based on predefined criteria. 
・Scenarios validate the smart contract's ability to update the reputation score accurately after a valid review submission and to unlock reviews using correct validation logic. 
・The test suite includes checks to ensure that only authorized users (identified by PubKeyHash) can redeem reviews and that the contract rejects attempts by unauthorized addresses. 
・Tests verify the contract's robustness by attempting to submit malformed data and ensuring that the validator script correctly identifies and rejects such submissions. 
・Further scenarios explore edge cases like handling multiple reviews, preventing double reviews for the same booking, and ensuring the correctness of the output datum upon review redemption. 

Test Case Report CardanoRnR
 Link : https://github.com/AIQUANT-Tech/CardanoRnR/tree
